implementation: One operation per LongList chunk; shared fixed ExecutorService and CompletableFuture; four snapshot groups

provenance.note: Exact previously benchmarked JAR reused without rebuilding; source revision comes from the original artifact record. Both approaches share one archive and runner.

fixture.inventoryScope: Relative names, sizes and modification times; not file-content hashes

measurement.timedOperation: Snapshot call only; source preparation, forcing files after return, validation and cleanup are excluded
measurement.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of all nine raw samples per cell; no samples discarded
measurement.sampleOrder: Within each block, samples retain their original measurement order
measurement.orderCaveat: Complete task matrix followed by complete fixed-pool matrix, not interleaved paired trials. Baseline was measured the previous day.

validation.scope: Index sizes and headers, boundary values, metadata and nonempty store directories; not an exhaustive restoration comparison

forcingAfterReturn.pairing: Each JMH trial has one warmup and three measured snapshots; the first force event is excluded and the remaining events are matched by iteration number to raw JMH samples.
forcingAfterReturn.caveat: Snapshot plus subsequent file forcing is diagnostic only, not end-to-end durable-snapshot latency; setup, validation, cleanup and directory durability are not included.

baseline.mapping: B = 3 × P; approximate total configured writer budget, not equal per-list concurrency.

comparisonReferences.blockComparisonCaveat: Matching block labels do not make these paired experiments.

resourceMonitoring.finding: No substantial competing userspace workload or memory pressure observed during this monitored rerun
resourceMonitoring.caveat: Thirty-second samples are not exclusive reservation or per-process disk attribution. Short-lived processes can escape process snapshots. Java identification uses readiness, three sequential driver lifetimes, 75 transient forks and at most two concurrent Java processes; top records command names, not full command lines.
